name_zh: 勃兰特/德国/东方政策/跪地谢罪/诺贝尔/社民党
description_zh: 维利·勃兰特 (1913-1992) 西德总理 (1969-1974)，东方政策缓和与东欧关系，华沙跪地谢罪成为历史和解象征，诺贝尔和平奖肯定和解努力，社民党现代化确立福利国家新阶段，1974年因间谍案辞职。
description_en: Willy Brandt (1913-1992) West German Chancellor (1969-1974), Ostpolitik detente with Eastern Europe, Warsaw kneeling apology became historical reconciliation symbol, Nobel Peace Prize affirmed reconciliation efforts, SPD modernization established welfare state new stage, 1974 resigned over spy scandal.
reason_zh: 勃兰特代表战败国如何通过主动承认历史罪责实现道德重生，展示了东方政策如何通过接触而非隔离化解冷战对抗，其跪地谢罪成为转型正义全球范式，诺贝尔和平奖加冕道德权威。
reason_en: Brandt represents how defeated nation achieves moral rebirth through proactive historical guilt admission, demonstrating how Ostpolitik resolves Cold War confrontation through engagement not isolation, his kneeling apology becoming transitional justice global paradigm, Nobel Peace Prize crowning moral authority.
steps_zh: 研究勃兰特早年纳粹迫害/流亡挪威/战后回归
分析1969年社民党执政与东方政策启动
探讨1970年华沙跪地/莫斯科条约/华沙条约
评估诺贝尔和平奖/1974年吉列间谍案辞职
总结东方政策/跪地谢罪/诺贝尔/福利国家四重遗产
steps_en: Study Brandt early Nazi persecution/Norway exile/postwar return
Analyze 1969 SPD governance and Ostpolitik launch
Evaluate Nobel Peace Prize/1974 Guillaime spy scandal resignation
expected_zh: 掌握道德勇气如何转化为外交突破，理解接触政策如何化解冷战僵局，评估勃兰特跪地谢罪对德国统一/欧洲一体化/转型正义的决定性贡献。
expected_en: Master how moral courage transforms into diplomatic breakthrough, grasp engagement policy resolving Cold War deadlock, evaluate Brandt kneeling decisive contribution for German reunification/European integration/transitional justice.
case_zh: 1969 总理；1970 华沙跪地/莫斯科条约；1971 诺贝尔；1974 辞职。东方政策/跪地谢罪/诺贝尔/福利国家范式永存。
case_en: 1969 Chancellor; 1970 Warsaw kneeling/Moscow Treaty; 1971 Nobel; 1974 resignation. Ostpolitik/kneeling/Nobel/welfare state paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Ostpolitik; kneeling apology; Nobel Peace; welfare state; Cold War detente
